description: The briefing happy path: a plain-NL 'what happened' ask must make the live agent choose briefInbox and actually produce a briefing (briefingPresent is read from the briefings rows, so a not_connected degradation FAILS rather than silently passing). Reading the inbox actuates nothing: no plan is proposed, no recipient added, no attachment made. Needles are body-only strings from the seeded fixture — they must reach no audit/DLQ/telemetry row.
turns: What happened in my inbox today?
